# Jeffrey Nortey

> Official site of Jeffrey Nortey — a Ghanaian actor, comedian, content creator and spoken-word artist. Known for viral skits, "Vibes" (2025), and stage work at Ghana's National Theatre.

## About
Jeffrey Nortey is a charismatic, versatile entertainer based in Accra, Ghana. Actor, comedian, artist. Represented informally; bookings via godfreybrewn@gmail.com.
